Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Specify the folder containing the CSV files
folder_path <- "output/"
```
Load in hour activity data and concatenate
```{r}
# List all CSV files in the folder with the *minute.csv pattern
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "*hour.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize an empty data frame to store the combined data
combined_data <- data.frame()

# Loop through each CSV file and rbind them
for (file_path in file_list) {
  # Read the CSV file
  data <- read_csv(file_path)
  
  # Combine (rbind) the filtered data with the existing combined_data
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data, data)  
}

combined_data$Time <- format(strptime(combined_data$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S"), format = "%H:%M")
combined_data_activity<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(combined_data)))
```
Load in sleep data and concatenate
```{r}
# List all CSV files in the folder with the *minute.csv pattern
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "*sleep.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize an empty data frame to store the combined data
combined_data <- data.frame()

# Loop through each CSV file and rbind them
for (file_path in file_list) {
  # Read the CSV file
  data <- read_csv(file_path)
  
  # Combine (rbind) the filtered data with the existing combined_data
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data, data)  
}

combined_data$Time <- format(strptime(combined_data$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S"), format = "%H:%M")
combined_data_sleep<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(combined_data)))
```


Filtering data as desired
```{r}
combined_data_activity<-combined_data_activity%>%filter(Geno=="CS"&treatAdult=="Ctrl"&treatLarvae=="Ctrl")
combined_data_sleep<-combined_data_sleep%>%filter(Geno=="CS"&treatAdult=="Ctrl"&treatLarvae=="Ctrl")
```
Determining overlapping ages and filtering only ages 4-7 days for all experiments
```{r}
age_range <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Experiment) %>%
  summarise(max = max(AgeD), min = min(AgeD))

combined_data_sleep<-combined_data_sleep%>%filter(AgeD>="4"&AgeD<=7)
combined_data_activity<-combined_data_activity%>%filter(AgeD>="4"&AgeD<=7)
```
Save out file for activity levels and sleep notebooks
```{r}
saveRDS(combined_data_activity, "output/combined_data_activity.rds")
saveRDS(combined_data_sleep, "output/combined_data_sleep.rds")
```
